name: Reverse super on a switching block: the floor swaps away under the dash, coyote keeps the super
techNote: The dot stands on a blue platform (x -100-100, blue active at the start), the only floor over a spike bed 600 u below; the finish box is on a ledge to the left (x -1250 to -650). A dash with blockSwapUnlocked swaps the colours, so the platform goes off under the dash: on the dash's first tick the ground check already misses (lab replay's solid0) while onGround is held at coyoteFrames 6/6. The jump on dash frame 1 is still a super (CheckForSuperJump only needs onGround), and with the dash to the right and the stick held left (lockX -1) it is the reverse super: 805 up and 876 momentum to the left, over the gap onto the ledge, the finish box on tick 55. The 'jump' demo (a plain jump left, no dash: the platform stays) comes down at x ~-430 and falls into the spikes.
